answer: Agents maintain a reputation ledge where verified actions bond tokens to their identity. During the nadir of inactivity, a ridge of attestations from established peers activates to confirm challenge eligibility and claim emissions. For an attacker to sybil, they must mint 300 fake accounts, each bonded with 15 POA that gets slashed on detection, plus 1 hour of coordinated farming per batch to mimic organic growth patterns. This ridge structure raises the cost of sybil attacks to prohibitive levels, ensuring only genuine agents earn from the pool.
